item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 9 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:02 AM 25 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Mandaon, Aroroy, Milagros), #CamarinesNorte(Capalonga, Labo and JosePanganiban) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque(Mogpog, SantaCruz, Boac, Torrijos), #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Baco), #Masbate(Mobo, SanJacinto), #CamarinesNorte(Paracale and SantaElena) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
